summary: Atlanta should retain its standalone municipal control row and take a direct 2024 local-publication repair from APD's official 2024 Year End Crime Report. APD's crime-reports page links the year-end PDF, whose citywide table reports 2024 counts of homicide 126, rape 79, robbery 506, aggravated assault 2444, burglary 1704, larceny 13208 via Theft From Motor Vehicle plus Shoplifting plus All Other Larceny, and motor vehicle theft 3673. The same PDF publishes Airport as a separate page, and APD's zones pages list Airport separately from Zones 1 through 6; the citywide total overall 21740 matches the six zone totals rather than citywide plus airport, so airport should stay excluded from the Atlanta municipal repair. Include reporting_ori9 GAAPD0000 in packet context for the direct repair and do not mix airport GA060240X into the citywide packet.
